text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Rice Shower is in her signature<n>racewear for
an interview. She's<n>currently on standby.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Deep breaths, deep breaths... In... and<n>out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A little...

But I got the questions beforehand<n>and was able to
practice my answers,<n>so I'll be okay!

She's still speaking when the<n>interviewer runs over
toward us in a<n>panic.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Rice Shower. I'm so<n>sorry, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
The questions we sent you before<n>were actually
intended for a different<n>interview...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
There was some kind of mix-up, and<n>they were
given to you by mistake.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

You have my sincerest apologies! I<n>understand that
you've prepared<n>answers for those questions...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: What should we do? Do we have to<n>cancel?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even the interview staff look troubled.<n>I'm also
thinking about what we<n>should do, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...A-actually!

You can... ask me whatever you want!<n>Even
questions I didn't prepare for<n>are okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I can answer, then I will.

R-really? If you're sure, that would<n>really help us
out.
choice_data_list:
If that's okay with you, then please let her do the
interview.

If that's okay with you, then please let her do the
interview.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as you're both okay<n>with it... Thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Truly, thank you! Shall we get started<n>then?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower answers the questions<n>confidently,
and the interview goes<n>off without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...How did I do, Big Brother?
choice_data_list: How do you think you did?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...How did I do, Big Sister?
choice_data_list: How do you think you did?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got so much courage from wearing<n>these clothes
during the interview. It<n>was just like when I'm
racing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... But not just the clothes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What's supported me the most... and<n>given me the
most courage...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is you, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is you, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She cracks a small, happy smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I think that—well, just a little bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm finally worthy of wearing these<n>clothes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's embarrassing to say that<n>about myself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That's because you believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That's because you believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So please, please, always believe in<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I nod reassuringly, and she smiles at<n>me joyfully.
